reviewItem.question: Does "Added `SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER` with a default value of `0.01` to introduce a randomized offset in `SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO`. Without this…" mean a change to env-var:istio|name=SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER (added)?

proposed.statement: Istio adds the env var SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER (default 0.01), which randomizes certificate renewal timing by about +/- 15 minutes around the 12-hour renewal.
